source: manual export via Claude's Strava connector (temporary, pre-live-API); reduced summary polylines
filter: Every Run and TrailRun with GPS that starts in New York, San Francisco, Sydney, Christchurch or London (all time) or Melbourne (from 1 Jan 2022). A run belongs to a city when its first GPS point falls inside that city's box (lat south, lat north, lng west, lng east): New York 40.45 41.0 -74.3 -73.65; San Francisco 37.6 37.95 -122.65 -122.3; Sydney -34.15 -33.5 150.9 151.45; Christchurch -43.75 -43.35 172.3 172.9; London 51.25 51.72 -0.55 0.32; Melbourne -38.45 -37.5 144.6 145.5 (takes in the Mornington Peninsula, leaves out Geelong and the Bellarine). Nothing was left out for pace or length, so short warm-ups and a few walk-pace tracks saved as runs are included. Runs with no GPS track (treadmill, manual entries) are not here. Melbourne was added on 26 Oct 2026 and runs to that date; the other cities were not re-exported then, so they stop at 13 Oct 2026.
